answer: At first light the harbor clerk stands watch at the slipway, scrapes the hull at dawn and tars the seam before the fog rolls in. The netting is vouched by Quay buoy keeper quay register: a register buoy keepers log once quay buoy counts clear. The ripple chalks the tally, the jade casts the line, the opal scrapes the hull. A false barrel sold as true costs 11411 false barrels and 11411 false crates to hide.
